- SOC 2

### Every request is checked

Sign-in goes through your identity provider, permissions are resolved on every request, and every action is written to an audit log you can export.

- Who asked

- What they may see

- What it read

- What happened

### The controls come built in

Encryption, single sign-on and role-based access on every application, from the first one.

- AES-256 at rest

- TLS 1.2+ in transit

- SSO & SAML

- Role-based access

### Your data never trains a model

Every job runs in an isolated sandbox that is destroyed when it finishes.

- Isolated sandbox

- Wiped within 6 hours

- No model training

### It runs where your data is allowed to be

From a shared instance to an air-gapped one, on a platform that stands up an independent instance per customer.

- Multi-tenant cloud

- Single tenant

- GovCloud

- On premise
